A 7-character catastrophic pattern such as `(a+)+$` passes the `length > MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH` check and is compiled with `new RegExp`, then executed synchronously per line via `regex.exec(line)` against input permitted up to 500 000 characters (`MAX_CODE_LENGTH` for `code`, `MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES` for `path`). Exponential backtracking on a long non-matching line still blocks the event loop, so the claimed ReDoS prevention is not achieved; adding a structural safe-regex check or a bounded/timeout execution is the concrete fix.
